tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload a local image file (png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, svg) to Sanity as an image asset. Returns the asset ID, CDN URL, and an image `reference` object ready to set on any image field.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the image file

alt.description: Alt text (derived from filename if omitted)

projectId.description: Sanity project ID (falls back to SANITY_PROJECT_ID env)

dataset.description: Sanity dataset (falls back to SANITY_DATASET env, then 'production')

tools.name: upload_and_set
tools.description: Upload a local image and set it on a field of an existing Sanity document in one call. Overwrites the current value of that field. Use groq_query first to find the document ID.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the image file

fieldPath.description: Path to the image field, dot-separated for nested objects (e.g. 'hero.image')

alt.description: Alt text (derived from filename if omitted)

projectId.description: Sanity project ID (falls back to SANITY_PROJECT_ID env)

dataset.description: Sanity dataset (falls back to SANITY_DATASET env, then 'production')

tools.name: batch_upload
tools.description: Upload every image (png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, svg) in a local folder as Sanity assets. Does not patch any documents. Files that fail are reported in `failed` while the rest still upload. Returns asset IDs, URLs and ready-to-use image references.

directory.description: Path to the folder with images

projectId.description: Sanity project ID (falls back to SANITY_PROJECT_ID env)

dataset.description: Sanity dataset (falls back to SANITY_DATASET env, then 'production')

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: List image files (png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, svg) in a local directory with their sizes, so you can see what is available to upload. Does not contact Sanity.

directory.description: Path to the directory to list

tools.name: groq_query
tools.description: Run a read-only GROQ query against the Sanity dataset and return the result as JSON. Useful to find document IDs and field names before upload_and_set.

projectId.description: Sanity project ID (falls back to SANITY_PROJECT_ID env)

dataset.description: Sanity dataset (falls back to SANITY_DATASET env, then 'production')
